lemma sign_step:
  fixes x y z :: real
  assumes xz: "x * z \<le> 0"
    and xy_bad: "\<not> x * y \<le> 0"
  shows "y * z \<le> 0"
proof -
  (* La segunda hipótesis expresa que el producto es estrictamente positivo. *)
  have xy_pos: "0 < x * y"
    using xy_bad by linarith

  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "x = 0")
    case True
    (* Si x es cero, el producto x*y no puede ser positivo. *)
    then show ?thesis using xy_pos by simp
  next
    case False
    have x_nonzero: "x \<noteq> 0" using False .

    (* Como x no es cero, es positivo o negativo. *)
    consider (pos) "0 < x" | (neg) "x < 0"
      using x_nonzero by linarith
    then show ?thesis
    proof cases
      case pos
      have x_nonneg: "0 \<le> x" using pos by linarith

      (* Con x positivo, xy positivo obliga a que y sea positivo. *)
      have y_pos: "0 < y"
      proof (rule ccontr)
        assume not_y_pos: "\<not> 0 < y"
        have y_nonpos: "y \<le> 0" using not_y_pos by linarith
        have "x * y \<le> x * 0"
          by (rule mult_left_mono[OF y_nonpos x_nonneg])
        then have "x * y \<le> 0" by simp
        then show False using xy_pos by linarith
      qed

      (* Con x positivo y xz no positivo, z no puede ser positivo. *)
      have z_nonpos: "z \<le> 0"
      proof (rule ccontr)
        assume not_z_nonpos: "\<not> z \<le> 0"
        have z_pos: "0 < z" using not_z_nonpos by linarith
        have "0 < x * z" by (rule mult_pos_pos[OF pos z_pos])
        then show False using xz by linarith
      qed

      (* Multiplicar z <= 0 por y >= 0 conserva la desigualdad. *)
      have "y * z \<le> y * 0"
        by (rule mult_left_mono[OF z_nonpos]) (use y_pos in linarith)
      then show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case neg
      have x_nonpos: "x \<le> 0" using neg by linarith

      (* Con x negativo, xy positivo obliga a que y sea negativo. *)
      have y_neg: "y < 0"
      proof (rule ccontr)
        assume not_y_neg: "\<not> y < 0"
        have y_nonneg: "0 \<le> y" using not_y_neg by linarith
        have "y * x \<le> y * 0"
          by (rule mult_left_mono[OF x_nonpos y_nonneg])
        then have "x * y \<le> 0" by (simp add: mult.commute)
        then show False using xy_pos by linarith
      qed
      have y_nonpos: "y \<le> 0" using y_neg by linarith

      (* Si z fuera negativo, el producto de -x y -z sería positivo. *)
      have z_nonneg: "0 \<le> z"
      proof (rule ccontr)
        assume not_z_nonneg: "\<not> 0 \<le> z"
        have z_neg: "z < 0" using not_z_nonneg by linarith
        have neg_x_pos: "0 < -x" using neg by linarith
        have neg_z_pos: "0 < -z" using z_neg by linarith
        have "0 < (-x) * (-z)"
          by (rule mult_pos_pos[OF neg_x_pos neg_z_pos])
        then have "0 < x * z" by (simp add: algebra_simps)
        then show False using xz by linarith
      qed

      (* Multiplicar y <= 0 por z >= 0 da el signo requerido. *)
      have "z * y \<le> z * 0"
        by (rule mult_left_mono[OF y_nonpos z_nonneg])
      then show ?thesis by (simp add: mult.commute)
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma cu_midpoint_halves:
  fixes l u :: real and P :: bool
  shows
    "snd (if P then (l, (l + u) / 2) else ((l + u) / 2, u)) -
     fst (if P then (l, (l + u) / 2) else ((l + u) / 2, u)) =
     (u - l) / 2"
proof (cases P)
  case True
  (* En la primera rama, la distancia entre l y el punto medio es la mitad. *)
  show ?thesis
    using True by (simp add: field_simps; linarith)
next
  case False
  (* En la segunda rama, la distancia entre el punto medio y u también es la mitad. *)
  show ?thesis
    using False by (simp add: field_simps; linarith)
qed

lemma cu_power_halving:
  fixes x :: real and k :: nat
  shows "(x / 2 ^ k) / 2 = x / 2 ^ Suc k"
proof -
  (* Dividir por dos equivale a incrementar en uno el exponente de dos. *)
  show ?thesis
    by (simp add: power_Suc divide_divide_eq_left)
qed

lemma cu_product_sign_transfer:
  fixes x y z :: real
  assumes xy: "x * y \<le> 0"
    and xz: "\<not> (x * z \<le> 0)"
  shows "z * y \<le> 0"
proof -
  (* La hipótesis sobre xz dice que ese producto es estrictamente positivo. *)
  have xz_pos: "0 < x * z"
    using xz by linarith

  (* En particular, x no puede ser cero. *)
  have x_nonzero: "x \<noteq> 0"
  proof
    assume x_zero: "x = 0"
    with xz_pos show False by simp
  qed

  (* Separamos los dos posibles signos de x. *)
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "x < 0")
    case True

    (* Si x es negativo, z también debe ser negativo. *)
    have x_nonpos: "x \<le> 0"
      using True by linarith
    have z_neg: "z < 0"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> z < 0"
      then have z_nonneg: "0 \<le> z" by linarith
      have "x * z \<le> 0"
        by (rule mult_nonpos_nonneg[OF x_nonpos z_nonneg])
      with xz_pos show False by linarith
    qed

    (* En este caso la hipótesis xy obliga a que y sea no negativo. *)
    have y_nonneg: "0 \<le> y"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> 0 \<le> y"
      then have y_neg: "y < 0" by linarith
      have neg_x_pos: "0 < -x"
        using True by linarith
      have neg_y_pos: "0 < -y"
        using y_neg by linarith
      have neg_product_pos: "0 < (-x) * (-y)"
        by (rule mult_pos_pos[OF neg_x_pos neg_y_pos])
      have "0 < x * y"
        using neg_product_pos by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      with xy show False by linarith
    qed

    (* El producto de un número no positivo y uno no negativo es no positivo. *)
    have z_nonpos: "z \<le> 0"
      using z_neg by linarith
    show ?thesis
      by (rule mult_nonpos_nonneg[OF z_nonpos y_nonneg])
  next
    case False

    (* Si x no es negativo ni cero, entonces es positivo. *)
    have x_pos: "0 < x"
      using x_nonzero False by linarith

    (* Como x es positivo y xz es positivo, z es positivo. *)
    have z_pos: "0 < z"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> 0 < z"
      then have z_nonpos: "z \<le> 0" by linarith
      have x_nonneg: "0 \<le> x"
        using x_pos by linarith
      have "x * z \<le> 0"
        by (rule mult_nonneg_nonpos[OF x_nonneg z_nonpos])
      with xz_pos show False by linarith
    qed

    (* La hipótesis xy obliga ahora a que y sea no positivo. *)
    have y_nonpos: "y \<le> 0"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> y \<le> 0"
      then have y_pos: "0 < y" by linarith
      have "0 < x * y"
        by (rule mult_pos_pos[OF x_pos y_pos])
      with xy show False by linarith
    qed

    (* El producto de un número no negativo y uno no positivo es no positivo. *)
    have z_nonneg: "0 \<le> z"
      using z_pos by linarith
    show ?thesis
      by (rule mult_nonneg_nonpos[OF z_nonneg y_nonpos])
  qed
qed

lemma cu_bisection_step_sign:
  fixes x y z :: real
  assumes xy: "x * y \<le> 0"
  shows "(if x * z \<le> 0 then x * z else z * y) \<le> 0"
proof (cases "x * z \<le> 0")
  case True

  (* Si el primer subinterval tiene cambio de signo, el producto elegido ya es no positivo. *)
  then show ?thesis by simp
next
  case False

  (* Si no, el lema de transferencia da el signo del segundo subintervalo. *)
  have zy: "z * y \<le> 0"
    by (rule cu_product_sign_transfer[OF xy False])
  then show ?thesis
    using False by simp
qed

lemma cu_bolzano_product:
  fixes g :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and x y :: real
  assumes xy: "x \<le> y"
    and contxy: "continuous_on {x..y} g"
    and signxy: "g x * g y \<le> 0"
  shows "\<exists>z. x \<le> z \<and> z \<le> y \<and> g z = 0"
proof -
  (* Si un extremo ya es raíz, ese extremo sirve como testigo. *)
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "g x = 0")
    case True
    show ?thesis using xy True by auto
  next
    case xne: False
    (* Consideramos también por separado el caso en que el extremo derecho es raíz. *)
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "g y = 0")
      case True
      show ?thesis using xy True by auto
    next
      case yne: False

      (* Sin raíces en los extremos, el producto no positivo fuerza signos estrictos opuestos. *)
      have signs:
        "(g x < 0 \<and> 0 < g y) \<or> (g y < 0 \<and> 0 < g x)"
      proof (cases "g x < 0")
        case True
        have gypos: "0 < g y"
        proof (rule ccontr)
          assume not_pos: "\<not> 0 < g y"
          have gyneg: "g y < 0" using not_pos yne by linarith
          have nx: "0 < - g x" using True by linarith
          have ny: "0 < - g y" using gyneg by linarith
          have prod_pos: "0 < (- g x) * (- g y)"
            by (rule mult_pos_pos[OF nx ny])
          have prod_eq: "g x * g y = (- g x) * (- g y)"
            by algebra
          show False using signxy prod_pos prod_eq by linarith
        qed
        show ?thesis using True gypos by blast
      next
        case False
        have gxpos: "0 < g x" using False xne by linarith
        have gyneg: "g y < 0"
        proof (rule ccontr)
          assume not_neg: "\<not> g y < 0"
          have gypos: "0 < g y" using not_neg yne by linarith
          have prod_pos: "0 < g x * g y"
            by (rule mult_pos_pos[OF gxpos gypos])
          show False using signxy prod_pos by linarith
        qed
        show ?thesis using gxpos gyneg by blast
      qed

      (* El teorema del valor intermedio cubre ambos órdenes de los signos. *)
      from signs show ?thesis
      proof
        assume left: "g x < 0 \<and> 0 < g y"
        have gx_le: "g x \<le> 0" using left by linarith
        have zero_le_gy: "0 \<le> g y" using left by linarith
        obtain z where z: "x \<le> z \<and> z \<le> y \<and> g z = 0"
          using IVT'[OF gx_le zero_le_gy xy contxy] by blast
        show ?thesis using z by blast
      next
        assume right: "g y < 0 \<and> 0 < g x"
        have gy_le: "g y \<le> 0" using right by linarith
        have zero_le_gx: "0 \<le> g x" using right by linarith
        obtain z where z: "x \<le> z \<and> z \<le> y \<and> g z = 0"
          using IVT2'[OF gy_le zero_le_gx xy contxy] by blast
        show ?thesis using z by blast
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma cu_deriv_bound_lipschitz:
  fixes f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and l u K :: real
  assumes order: "l \<le> u"
    and d: "\<And>t. t \<in> {l..u} \<Longrightarrow> (f has_real_derivative f' t) (at t)"
    and bound: "\<And>t. t \<in> {l..u} \<Longrightarrow> \<bar>f' t\<bar> \<le> K"
  shows "\<bar>f u - f l\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>u - l\<bar>"
proof -
  (* Si los extremos coinciden, ambos lados son cero. *)
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "l = u")
    case True
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    (* En el caso no degenerado, obtenemos los requisitos del teorema del valor medio. *)
    have strict: "l < u" using order False by linarith
    have der: "\<And>t. l \<le> t \<Longrightarrow> t \<le> u \<Longrightarrow>
        (f has_real_derivative f' t) (at t)"
      using d by auto
    (* El valor medio expresa la diferencia de valores mediante una derivada interior. *)
    obtain z where zl: "l < z" and zu: "z < u"
      and eq: "f u - f l = (u - l) * f' z"
      using MVT2[OF strict der] by blast
    have zmem: "z \<in> {l..u}" using zl zu by simp
    (* Aplicamos la cota de la derivada en el punto obtenido. *)
    have bz: "\<bar>f' z\<bar> \<le> K" using bound zmem by blast
    (* Multiplicamos por la distancia, que es no negativa. *)
    have prod: "\<bar>u - l\<bar> * \<bar>f' z\<bar> \<le> \<bar>u - l\<bar> * K"
      by (rule mult_left_mono[OF bz]) simp
    have abs_eq: "\<bar>f u - f l\<bar> = \<bar>u - l\<bar> * \<bar>f' z\<bar>"
      using eq by (simp add: abs_mult)
    (* Encadenamos la igualdad del valor medio con la cota del producto. *)
    show ?thesis
    proof -
      have "\<bar>f u - f l\<bar> = \<bar>u - l\<bar> * \<bar>f' z\<bar>" by (rule abs_eq)
      also have "... \<le> \<bar>u - l\<bar> * K" by (rule prod)
      also have "... = K * \<bar>u - l\<bar>" by (simp add: mult.commute)
      finally show ?thesis .
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma cu_funpow_closed:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and S :: "'a set" and z :: "'a" and m :: nat
  assumes start: "z \<in> S"
    and closed: "\<And>x. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> f x \<in> S"
  shows "(f ^^ m) z \<in> S"
proof (induction m)
  case 0
  (* La iteración de orden cero deja el punto inicial sin cambios. *)
  show ?case
    using start by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  (* El iterado anterior está en S y la clausura da el siguiente. *)
  show ?case
    using closed[OF Suc.IH] by simp
qed

lemma cu_contraction_fixed_unique:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and c x y :: real
  assumes c_nonneg: "0 \<le> c"
    and c_less_one: "c < 1"
    and contraction: "\<bar>f x - f y\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
    and fixed_x: "f x = x"
    and fixed_y: "f y = y"
  shows "x = y"
proof -
  (* Usando que ambos puntos son fijos, la contracción acota su distancia por sí misma. *)
  have distance_bound: "\<bar>x - y\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
    using contraction fixed_x fixed_y by simp

  (* Reescribimos la diferencia de ambos lados como un producto. *)
  have difference_nonpos: "\<bar>x - y\<bar> - c * \<bar>x - y\<bar> \<le> 0"
    using distance_bound by linarith
  have product_eq:
    "(1 - c) * \<bar>x - y\<bar> = \<bar>x - y\<bar> - c * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have product_nonpos: "(1 - c) * \<bar>x - y\<bar> \<le> 0"
    using product_eq difference_nonpos by linarith

  (* Como 1-c es positivo, una distancia positiva daría un producto positivo. *)
  have distance_zero: "\<bar>x - y\<bar> = 0"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume distance_nonzero: "\<bar>x - y\<bar> \<noteq> 0"
    have distance_positive: "0 < \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
      using distance_nonzero by simp
    have factor_positive: "0 < 1 - c"
      using c_less_one by linarith
    have "0 < (1 - c) * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
      using factor_positive distance_positive by (rule mult_pos_pos)
    with product_nonpos show False by linarith
  qed

  (* Una diferencia absoluta nula implica que los puntos coinciden. *)
  show "x = y"
    using distance_zero by simp
qed

lemma cu_iterate_contraction_bound:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and S :: "real set"
    and c z q :: real and m :: nat
  assumes c_nonneg: "0 \<le> c"
    and z_in: "z \<in> S"
    and q_in: "q \<in> S"
    and invariant: "\<And>x. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> f x \<in> S"
    and lip: "\<And>x y. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> S \<Longrightarrow>
      \<bar>f x - f y\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
    and fixpoint: "f q = q"
  shows "\<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar> \<le> c ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
proof (induction m)
  case 0
  (* Para cero, el iterado y la potencia se simplifican. *)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  (* El iterado anterior permanece en el conjunto invariante. *)
  have prev_in: "(f ^^ m) z \<in> S"
    by (rule cu_funpow_closed[OF z_in invariant])

  (* Aplicamos la contracción entre el iterado anterior y el punto fijo. *)
  have contraction_step:
    "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - f q\<bar> \<le>
      c * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar>"
    by (rule lip[OF prev_in q_in])

  (* La hipótesis inductiva se puede multiplicar por c, que es no negativo. *)
  have product_bound:
    "c * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar> \<le>
      c * (c ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>)"
    by (rule mult_left_mono[OF Suc.IH c_nonneg])

  (* Usamos que q es punto fijo para expresar el primer paso de la iteración. *)
  have fixed_step:
    "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - q\<bar> \<le>
      c * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar>"
    using contraction_step fixpoint by simp

  (* La regla de sucesor de la potencia da el factor requerido. *)
  have power_step:
    "c ^ Suc m * \<bar>z - q\<bar> =
      c * (c ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>)"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps)

  (* Encadenamos la contracción, la cota inductiva y la identidad de potencias. *)
  have chain:
    "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - q\<bar> \<le>
      c ^ Suc m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
  proof -
    have "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - q\<bar> \<le>
        c * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar>"
      by fact
    also have "\<dots> \<le> c * (c ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>)"
      by fact
    also have "\<dots> = c ^ Suc m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
      by (rule sym[OF power_step])
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed

  (* La forma sucesora del iterado convierte esta cadena en la meta. *)
  have iter_suc: "(f ^^ Suc m) z = f ((f ^^ m) z)"
    by simp
  show ?case using chain iter_suc by simp
qed

lemma cu_iterated_contraction_bound:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and S :: "real set"
    and K z q :: real and m :: nat
  assumes start: "z \<in> S"
    and point: "q \<in> S"
    and closed: "\<And>x. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> f x \<in> S"
    and contract: "\<And>x y. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> S \<Longrightarrow>
      \<bar>f x - f y\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
    and fixed_point: "f q = q"
    and nonneg: "0 \<le> K"
  shows "\<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar> \<le> K ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
proof (induction m)
  case 0
  (* Para cero iteraciones, la cota es una igualdad. *)
  show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  (* El iterado previo sigue perteneciendo al dominio invariante. *)
  have image: "(f ^^ m) z \<in> S"
    by (rule cu_funpow_closed[OF start closed])

  (* Aplicamos la contracción entre el iterado previo y el punto fijo. *)
  have one_step:
    "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - f q\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar>"
    by (rule contract[OF image point])

  (* Escalamos la hipótesis inductiva usando que K es no negativo. *)
  have scaled:
    "K * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar> \<le> K * (K ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>)"
    by (rule mult_left_mono[OF Suc.IH nonneg])

  (* Encadenamos la contracción y la cota inductiva, y reescribimos la potencia. *)
  have "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - f q\<bar>
      \<le> K * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar>"
    using one_step .
  also have "\<dots> \<le> K * (K ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>)"
    using scaled .
  finally show ?case
    using fixed_point by (simp add: power_Suc mult_ac)
qed

lemma cu_interval_distance_bound_v3:
  fixes l u x y :: real
  assumes order: "l \<le> u"
    and x_in: "x \<in> {l..u}"
    and y_in: "y \<in> {l..u}"
  shows "\<bar>x - y\<bar> \<le> u - l"
proof -
  (* Cada punto del intervalo está entre sus dos extremos. *)
  have lx: "l \<le> x" and xu: "x \<le> u"
    using x_in by auto
  have ly: "l \<le> y" and yu: "y \<le> u"
    using y_in by auto

  (* La diferencia está acotada por la longitud del intervalo. *)
  have upper: "x - y \<le> u - l"
    using xu ly by linarith
  have lower: "- (u - l) \<le> x - y"
    using lx yu by linarith

  (* Según el signo de la diferencia, su valor absoluto es ella o su opuesto. *)
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "0 \<le> x - y")
    case True
    have "\<bar>x - y\<bar> = x - y"
      by (rule abs_of_nonneg[OF True])
    then show ?thesis
      using upper by simp
  next
    case False
    have nonpos: "x - y \<le> 0"
      using False by linarith
    have "\<bar>x - y\<bar> = - (x - y)"
      by (rule abs_of_nonpos[OF nonpos])
    then show ?thesis
      using lower by linarith
  qed
qed

lemma cu_interval_distance_bound_final:
  fixes l u x y :: real
  assumes order: "l \<le> u"
    and x_in: "x \<in> {l..u}"
    and y_in: "y \<in> {l..u}"
  shows "\<bar>x - y\<bar> \<le> u - l"
proof -
  (* Cada punto del intervalo está entre sus extremos. *)
  have lx: "l \<le> x" and xu: "x \<le> u"
    using x_in by auto
  have ly: "l \<le> y" and yu: "y \<le> u"
    using y_in by auto

  (* La diferencia y su opuesto están acotados por la longitud. *)
  have upper: "x - y \<le> u - l"
    using xu ly by linarith
  have lower: "- (u - l) \<le> x - y"
    using lx yu by linarith

  (* El signo de la diferencia permite concluir la cota absoluta. *)
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "0 \<le> x - y")
    case True
    have "\<bar>x - y\<bar> = x - y"
      by (rule abs_of_nonneg[OF True])
    then show ?thesis
      using upper by simp
  next
    case False
    have nonpos: "x - y \<le> 0"
      using False by linarith
    have "\<bar>x - y\<bar> = - (x - y)"
      by (rule abs_of_nonpos[OF nonpos])
    then show ?thesis
      using lower by linarith
  qed
qed

lemma cu_iterated_contraction_bound_final:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and S :: "real set"
    and K z q :: real and m :: nat
  assumes start: "z \<in> S"
    and point: "q \<in> S"
    and closed: "\<And>x. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> f x \<in> S"
    and contract: "\<And>x y. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> S \<Longrightarrow>
      \<bar>f x - f y\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
    and fixed_point: "f q = q"
    and nonneg: "0 \<le> K"
  shows "\<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar> \<le> K ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
proof (induction m)
  case 0
  (* Sin iteraciones, la distancia coincide con la cota. *)
  show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  (* El iterado previo permanece en el conjunto invariante. *)
  have image: "(f ^^ m) z \<in> S"
    by (rule cu_funpow_closed[OF start closed])

  (* Aplicamos la contracción entre el iterado y el punto fijo. *)
  have one_step:
    "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - f q\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar>"
    by (rule contract[OF image point])
  have one_step':
    "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - q\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar>"
    using one_step fixed_point by simp

  (* Escalamos la hipótesis inductiva por el factor no negativo. *)
  have scaled:
    "K * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar> \<le> K * (K ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>)"
    by (rule mult_left_mono[OF Suc.IH nonneg])

  (* Encadenamos el paso de contracción con la cota inductiva. *)
  have combined:
    "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - q\<bar> \<le> K * (K ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>)"
    using one_step' scaled by linarith
  show ?case
    using combined by (simp add: power_Suc algebra_simps)
qed

lemma cu_interval_endpoint_bound:
  fixes l u x y :: real
  assumes x_mem: "x \<in> {l..u}"
    and y_mem: "y \<in> {l..u}"
  shows "\<bar>x - y\<bar> \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
proof -
  (* La pertenencia al intervalo da las cotas de ambos puntos. *)
  have lx: "l \<le> x" and xu: "x \<le> u"
    using x_mem by auto
  have ly: "l \<le> y" and yu: "y \<le> u"
    using y_mem by auto

  (* Las distancias desde x a los extremos están acotadas por el máximo. *)
  have left_bound: "x - l \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
    by (rule max.cobounded1)
  have right_bound: "u - x \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
    by (rule max.cobounded2)

  (* Las cotas de y y de los extremos acotan x - y por ambos lados. *)
  have upper: "x - y \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
    using ly left_bound by linarith
  have lower: "- max (x - l) (u - x) \<le> x - y"
    using yu right_bound by linarith

  (* Escribimos explícitamente la desigualdad para el opuesto de x - y. *)
  have neg_upper: "- (x - y) \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
    using lower by linarith

  (* La caracterización del valor absoluto concluye la cota. *)
  show ?thesis
    using upper neg_upper by (simp add: abs_le_iff)
qed

lemma cu_fixedpoint_first_step_bound:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and S :: "real set"
    and c z q :: real
  assumes c_nonneg: "0 \<le> c"
    and c_less_one: "c < 1"
    and z_in: "z \<in> S"
    and q_in: "q \<in> S"
    and invariant: "\<And>x. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> f x \<in> S"
    and lip: "\<And>x y. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> S \<Longrightarrow>
      \<bar>f x - f y\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
    and fixpoint: "f q = q"
  shows "\<bar>z - q\<bar> \<le> \<bar>f z - z\<bar> / (1 - c)"
proof -
  (* La contracción aplicada entre z y el punto fijo acota el siguiente error. *)
  have lip_z: "\<bar>f z - q\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
    using lip[OF z_in q_in] fixpoint by simp

  (* La desigualdad triangular relaciona el error actual con el primer paso. *)
  have tri: "\<bar>z - q\<bar> \<le> \<bar>f z - z\<bar> + c * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
  proof -
    have eq: "z - q = (z - f z) + (f z - q)" by algebra
    have swap: "\<bar>z - f z\<bar> = \<bar>f z - z\<bar>"
      by (simp add: abs_minus_commute)
    have "\<bar>z - q\<bar> = \<bar>(z - f z) + (f z - q)\<bar>"
      by (simp only: eq)
    also have "\<dots> \<le> \<bar>z - f z\<bar> + \<bar>f z - q\<bar>"
      by (rule abs_triangle_ineq)
    also have "\<dots> \<le> \<bar>f z - z\<bar> + c * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
      using swap lip_z by linarith
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed

  (* Reordenamos la cota triangular para aislar el factor 1-c. *)
  have ident: "(1 - c) * \<bar>z - q\<bar> = \<bar>z - q\<bar> - c * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
    by algebra
  have scaled: "(1 - c) * \<bar>z - q\<bar> \<le> \<bar>f z - z\<bar>"
    using tri ident by linarith

  (* El denominador es positivo, así que podemos dividir por él. *)
  have den_pos: "0 < 1 - c" using c_less_one by linarith
  have scaled_commuted: "\<bar>z - q\<bar> * (1 - c) \<le> \<bar>f z - z\<bar>"
    using scaled by (simp add: mult.commute)
  show ?thesis
    using scaled_commuted den_pos by (simp add: pos_le_divide_eq)
qed

lemma cu_iterate_first_step_bound:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and S :: "real set"
    and c z q :: real and m :: nat
  assumes c_nonneg: "0 \<le> c"
    and c_less_one: "c < 1"
    and z_in: "z \<in> S"
    and q_in: "q \<in> S"
    and invariant: "\<And>x. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> f x \<in> S"
    and lip: "\<And>x y. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> S \<Longrightarrow>
      \<bar>f x - f y\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
    and fixpoint: "f q = q"
  shows "\<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar> \<le> c ^ m / (1 - c) * \<bar>f z - z\<bar>"
proof -
  (* La contracción acota el error del iterado por el error inicial. *)
  have iter: "\<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar> \<le> c ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
    by (rule cu_iterate_contraction_bound
        [OF c_nonneg z_in q_in invariant lip fixpoint])

  (* La cota a priori controla el error inicial mediante el primer paso. *)
  have first: "\<bar>z - q\<bar> \<le> \<bar>f z - z\<bar> / (1 - c)"
    by (rule cu_fixedpoint_first_step_bound
        [OF c_nonneg c_less_one z_in q_in invariant lip fixpoint])

  (* La potencia del factor de contracción es no negativa. *)
  have pow_nonneg: "0 \<le> c ^ m"
  proof (induction m)
    case 0
    then show ?case by simp
  next
    case (Suc j)
    have "0 \<le> c * c ^ j"
      by (rule mult_nonneg_nonneg[OF c_nonneg Suc.IH])
    then show ?case by (simp add: power_Suc)
  qed

  (* Multiplicamos la cota del primer paso por esa potencia no negativa. *)
  have scaled:
    "c ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar> \<le>
      c ^ m * (\<bar>f z - z\<bar> / (1 - c))"
    by (rule mult_left_mono[OF first pow_nonneg])

  (* Reordenamos el producto para obtener la forma del enunciado. *)
  have rearranged:
    "c ^ m * (\<bar>f z - z\<bar> / (1 - c)) =
      c ^ m / (1 - c) * \<bar>f z - z\<bar>"
    by (simp add: divide_inverse algebra_simps)

  (* Encadenamos la cota de la iteración con la cota escalada. *)
  show ?thesis
    using iter scaled rearranged by linarith
qed

lemma cu_abs_posteriori:
  fixes c u v :: real
  assumes c_nonneg: "0 \<le> c"
    and c_less: "c < 1"
    and contraction: "\<bar>u\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>v\<bar>"
    and triangle: "\<bar>v\<bar> \<le> \<bar>u\<bar> + \<bar>v - u\<bar>"
  shows "\<bar>u\<bar> \<le> c / (1 - c) * \<bar>v - u\<bar>"
proof -
  (* El denominador que usaremos para despejar es positivo. *)
  have hc: "0 < 1 - c"
    using c_less by linarith

  (* La desigualdad triangular y la contracción acotan la distancia entre v y u. *)
  have hdiff: "(1 - c) * \<bar>v\<bar> \<le> \<bar>v - u\<bar>"
  proof -
    have heq: "(1 - c) * \<bar>v\<bar> = \<bar>v\<bar> - c * \<bar>v\<bar>"
      by algebra
    show ?thesis
      using triangle contraction heq by linarith
  qed

  (* Multiplicamos la cota de contracción por el factor positivo 1-c. *)
  have hscale1: "(1 - c) * \<bar>u\<bar> \<le> c * ((1 - c) * \<bar>v\<bar>)"
  proof -
    have h: "(1 - c) * \<bar>u\<bar> \<le> (1 - c) * (c * \<bar>v\<bar>)"
      by (rule mult_left_mono[OF contraction]) (use hc in linarith)
    have heq: "(1 - c) * (c * \<bar>v\<bar>) = c * ((1 - c) * \<bar>v\<bar>)"
      by algebra
    show ?thesis
      using h heq by simp
  qed

  (* Multiplicamos la cota de hdiff por el factor no negativo c. *)
  have hscale2: "c * ((1 - c) * \<bar>v\<bar>) \<le> c * \<bar>v - u\<bar>"
    by (rule mult_left_mono[OF hdiff]) (use c_nonneg in linarith)

  (* Encadenamos las cotas y expresamos el producto en el orden conveniente. *)
  have hfinal: "(1 - c) * \<bar>u\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>v - u\<bar>"
    by (rule order_trans[OF hscale1 hscale2])
  have hfinal': "\<bar>u\<bar> * (1 - c) \<le> c * \<bar>v - u\<bar>"
    using hfinal by (simp add: mult.commute)

  (* Despejamos usando que 1-c es positivo. *)
  have hquot: "\<bar>u\<bar> \<le> (c * \<bar>v - u\<bar>) / (1 - c)"
    using hc hfinal' by (simp add: pos_le_divide_eq)

  (* Reescribimos el cociente en la forma del enunciado. *)
  have hne: "1 - c \<noteq> 0"
    using hc by linarith
  have heq: "c / (1 - c) * \<bar>v - u\<bar> =
      (c * \<bar>v - u\<bar>) / (1 - c)"
    using hne by (simp add: field_simps)
  show ?thesis
    using hquot heq by simp
qed

lemma cu_real_lipschitz_continuous:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and S :: "real set" and L :: real
  assumes nonneg: "0 \<le> L"
    and lip: "\<And>x y. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> S \<Longrightarrow>
      \<bar>f x - f y\<bar> \<le> L * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
  shows "continuous_on S f"
proof -
  (* La cota en valor absoluto es precisamente una cota Lipschitz para la distancia real. *)
  have lip_metric: "L-lipschitz_on S f"
    using nonneg lip
    unfolding lipschitz_on_def
    by (auto simp: dist_real_def)
  (* Las funciones Lipschitz son continuas. *)
  show ?thesis
    by (rule Lipschitz.lipschitz_on_continuous_on[OF lip_metric])
qed

lemma cu_interval_endpoint_bounds:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and u v :: real
  assumes left: "f u \<in> {u..v}"
    and right: "f v \<in> {u..v}"
  shows "u \<le> f u \<and> f v \<le> v"
proof -
  (* La pertenencia a un intervalo cerrado proporciona las cotas de sus extremos. *)
  show ?thesis
    using left right by auto
qed

lemma cu_geometric_power_tends_zero:
  fixes r :: real
  assumes nonneg: "0 \<le> r"
    and less: "r < 1"
  shows "(\<lambda>n. r ^ n) \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0"
proof -
  (* La condición sobre r implica que la serie geométrica es sumable. *)
  have nr: "norm r < 1"
    using nonneg less by simp
  have summ: "summable (\<lambda>n. r ^ n)"
    using nr by (simp add: summable_geometric)

  (* Los términos de una serie sumable tienden a cero. *)
  show ?thesis
    using summable_LIMSEQ_zero[OF summ] .
qed

lemma cu_real_geometric_sequence_tends_zero:
  fixes r :: real
  assumes nonneg: "0 \<le> r"
    and less: "r < 1"
  shows "(\<lambda>n. r ^ n) \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0"
proof -
  (* La cota de r implica que la serie geométrica es sumable. *)
  have nr: "norm r < 1"
    using nonneg less by simp
  have summ: "summable (\<lambda>n. r ^ n)"
    using nr by (simp add: summable_geometric)

  (* Los términos de toda serie sumable tienden a cero. *)
  show ?thesis
    using summable_LIMSEQ_zero[OF summ] .
qed

lemma cu_abs_square:
  fixes r :: real
  shows "\<bar>r\<bar> * \<bar>r\<bar> = r\<^sup>2"
proof (cases "0 \<le> r")
  (* Con r no negativo, el valor absoluto se elimina directamente. *)
  case True
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: power2_eq_square)
next
  (* En el otro caso, r es no positivo y también se elimina el valor absoluto. *)
  case False
  have nonpositive: "r \<le> 0" using False by linarith
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: power2_eq_square)
qed

lemma cu_quadratic_derivative_step:
  fixes f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and l u q z K :: real
  assumes segment_order: "l \<le> u"
    and qin: "q \<in> {l..u}"
    and zin: "z \<in> {l..u}"
    and derivative_rule: "\<And>t. t \<in> {l..u} \<Longrightarrow> (f has_real_derivative f' t) (at t)"
    and derivative_estimate: "\<And>t. t \<in> {l..u} \<Longrightarrow> \<bar>f' t\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>t - q\<bar>"
    and scale_nonnegative: "0 \<le> K"
  shows "\<bar>f z - f q\<bar> \<le> K * (z - q)\<^sup>2"
proof -
  (* El producto de las distancias absolutas es el cuadrado correspondiente. *)
  have product: "(K * \<bar>z - q\<bar>) * \<bar>z - q\<bar> = K * (z - q)\<^sup>2"
  proof -
    have square: "\<bar>z - q\<bar> * \<bar>z - q\<bar> = (z - q)\<^sup>2"
      by (rule cu_abs_square)
    show ?thesis using square by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  qed

  (* Si q está a la izquierda de z, acotamos en [q,z]. *)
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "q \<le> z")
    case True
    have subinterval: "{q..z} \<subseteq> {l..u}"
      using qin zin True by auto
    have step: "\<bar>f z - f q\<bar> \<le> (K * \<bar>z - q\<bar>) * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
    proof (rule cu_deriv_bound_lipschitz)
      show "q \<le> z" using True .
    next
      fix t
      assume tmem: "t \<in> {q..z}"
      have in_parent: "t \<in> {l..u}"
        using subinterval tmem by blast
      show "(f has_real_derivative f' t) (at t)"
        using derivative_rule[OF in_parent] .
    next
      fix t
      assume tmem: "t \<in> {q..z}"
      have in_parent: "t \<in> {l..u}"
        using subinterval tmem by blast
      have endpoints: "q \<le> t" "t \<le> z" using tmem by auto
      have distance: "\<bar>t - q\<bar> \<le> \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
        using endpoints by (simp; linarith)
      have scaled: "K * \<bar>t - q\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
        by (rule mult_left_mono[OF distance scale_nonnegative])
      have derivative_bound: "\<bar>f' t\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>t - q\<bar>"
        using derivative_estimate[OF in_parent] .
      show "\<bar>f' t\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
        using derivative_bound scaled by linarith
    qed
    show ?thesis using step product by simp
  next
    (* Si z está a la izquierda de q, aplicamos la misma cota en [z,q]. *)
    case False
    have z_le_q: "z \<le> q" using False by linarith
    have subinterval: "{z..q} \<subseteq> {l..u}"
      using qin zin z_le_q by auto
    have reverse_step: "\<bar>f q - f z\<bar> \<le> (K * \<bar>z - q\<bar>) * \<bar>q - z\<bar>"
    proof (rule cu_deriv_bound_lipschitz)
      show "z \<le> q" using z_le_q .
    next
      fix t
      assume tmem: "t \<in> {z..q}"
      have in_parent: "t \<in> {l..u}"
        using subinterval tmem by blast
      show "(f has_real_derivative f' t) (at t)"
        using derivative_rule[OF in_parent] .
    next
      fix t
      assume tmem: "t \<in> {z..q}"
      have in_parent: "t \<in> {l..u}"
        using subinterval tmem by blast
      have endpoints: "z \<le> t" "t \<le> q" using tmem by auto
      have distance: "\<bar>t - q\<bar> \<le> \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
        using endpoints by (simp; linarith)
      have scaled: "K * \<bar>t - q\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
        by (rule mult_left_mono[OF distance scale_nonnegative])
      have derivative_bound: "\<bar>f' t\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>t - q\<bar>"
        using derivative_estimate[OF in_parent] .
      show "\<bar>f' t\<bar> \<le> K * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
        using derivative_bound scaled by linarith
    qed
    have step: "\<bar>f z - f q\<bar> \<le> (K * \<bar>z - q\<bar>) * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
      using reverse_step by (simp add: abs_minus_commute)
    show ?thesis using step product by simp
  qed
qed

lemma cu_deriv_nonnegative_nondecreasing:
  fixes f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and l u :: real
  assumes ord: "l \<le> u"
    and ddata: "\<And>t. t \<in> {l..u} \<Longrightarrow> (f has_real_derivative f' t) (at t)"
    and nonneg: "\<And>t. t \<in> {l..u} \<Longrightarrow> 0 \<le> f' t"
  shows "f l \<le> f u"
proof (rule Deriv.DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing[OF ord])
  (* La derivada dada es no negativa en cada punto del intervalo. *)
  fix t
  assume lt: "l \<le> t" and tu: "t \<le> u"
  have ti: "t \<in> {l..u}" using lt tu by simp
  show "\<exists>y. (f has_real_derivative y) (at t) \<and> 0 \<le> y"
    using ddata[OF ti] nonneg[OF ti] by blast
qed

lemma cu_abs_recurrence_bound:
  fixes a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real" and r :: real and k :: nat
  assumes r_nonneg: "0 \<le> r"
    and recurrence: "\<And>j. \<bar>a (Suc j)\<bar> \<le> r * \<bar>a j\<bar>"
  shows "\<bar>a k\<bar> \<le> r ^ k * \<bar>a 0\<bar>"
(* Por inducción, en el paso sucesor se escala la cota inductiva por el factor no negativo. *)
proof (induction k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc k)
  (* La recurrencia da el primer tramo de la cota del paso. *)
  have step: "\<bar>a (Suc k)\<bar> \<le> r * \<bar>a k\<bar>"
    using recurrence[of k] .

  (* La no negatividad de r permite escalar la hipótesis inductiva. *)
  have scaled: "r * \<bar>a k\<bar> \<le> r * (r ^ k * \<bar>a 0\<bar>)"
    using Suc.IH r_nonneg by (rule mult_left_mono)

  (* Se encadenan ambas cotas y se simplifica la potencia sucesora. *)
  have "\<bar>a (Suc k)\<bar> \<le> r * (r ^ k * \<bar>a 0\<bar>)"
    using step scaled by (rule order_trans)
  also have "... = r ^ Suc k * \<bar>a 0\<bar>"
    by (simp add: power_Suc algebra_simps)
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma cu_abs_recurrence_bound_v2:
  fixes a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real" and r :: real and k :: nat
  assumes r_nonneg: "0 \<le> r"
    and recurrence: "\<And>j. \<bar>a (Suc j)\<bar> \<le> r * \<bar>a j\<bar>"
  shows "\<bar>a k\<bar> \<le> r ^ k * \<bar>a 0\<bar>"
proof (induction k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc k)
  (* La recurrencia proporciona la cota para el paso actual. *)
  have step: "\<bar>a (Suc k)\<bar> \<le> r * \<bar>a k\<bar>"
    using recurrence[of k] .

  (* Se multiplica la hipótesis inductiva por el factor no negativo. *)
  have scaled: "r * \<bar>a k\<bar> \<le> r * (r ^ k * \<bar>a 0\<bar>)"
    using Suc.IH r_nonneg by (rule mult_left_mono)

  (* Se encadenan las cotas y se simplifica la potencia sucesora. *)
  have "\<bar>a (Suc k)\<bar> \<le> r * (r ^ k * \<bar>a 0\<bar>)"
    using step scaled by (rule order_trans)
  also have "... = r ^ Suc k * \<bar>a 0\<bar>"
    by (simp add: power_Suc algebra_simps)
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma cu_abs_square_scale:
  fixes c x y :: real
  assumes c_nonneg: "0 \<le> c"
    and bound: "\<bar>x\<bar> \<le> c * y\<^sup>2"
  shows "c * \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> (c * \<bar>y\<bar>)\<^sup>2"
proof -
  (* El cuadrado de un valor absoluto coincide con el cuadrado original. *)
  have abs_sq: "(\<bar>y\<bar>)\<^sup>2 = y\<^sup>2"
  proof (cases "0 \<le> y")
    case True
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    then have "y \<le> 0" by linarith
    then have "\<bar>y\<bar> = -y" by simp
    then show ?thesis by algebra
  qed
  (* Escalamos la cota usando que c es no negativo. *)
  have scaled: "c * \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> c * (c * y\<^sup>2)"
  proof (rule mult_left_mono)
    show "\<bar>x\<bar> \<le> c * y\<^sup>2" by (rule bound)
    show "0 \<le> c" by (rule c_nonneg)
  qed
  (* La expresión escalada es exactamente el cuadrado requerido. *)
  have equality: "c * (c * y\<^sup>2) = (c * \<bar>y\<bar>)\<^sup>2"
    using abs_sq by algebra
  show ?thesis
    using scaled equality by simp
qed

lemma cu_square_recurrence_bound:
  fixes a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real" and k :: nat
  assumes nonneg: "\<And>j. 0 \<le> a j"
    and recurrence: "\<And>j. a (Suc j) \<le> (a j)\<^sup>2"
  shows "a k \<le> (a 0) ^ (2 ^ k)"
proof (induction k)
  case 0
  show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc k)
  (* La hipótesis inductiva se eleva al cuadrado por monotonía. *)
  have square_bound: "(a k)\<^sup>2 \<le> (a 0 ^ (2 ^ k))\<^sup>2"
    using Suc.IH nonneg[of k] by (rule power_mono; assumption)

  (* Se reescribe el cuadrado como una potencia con exponente producto. *)
  have power_step:
    "(a 0 ^ (2 ^ k))\<^sup>2 = (a 0) ^ ((2 ^ k) * 2)"
    by (simp only: power_mult)

  (* El exponente en el paso sucesor es el producto por dos. *)
  have exp_step: "(2::nat) ^ Suc k = (2 ^ k) * 2"
    by (simp add: mult.commute)
  have exp_reverse: "(2 ^ k) * 2 = (2::nat) ^ Suc k"
    using exp_step by (rule sym)

  (* La congruencia transporta la igualdad de exponentes a las potencias reales. *)
  have exponent_step:
    "(a 0) ^ ((2 ^ k) * 2) = (a 0) ^ (2 ^ Suc k)"
    using exp_reverse
    by (rule arg_cong[where f = "\<lambda>m::nat. (a 0) ^ m"])

  (* Encadenamos la recurrencia, la cota inductiva y la igualdad de potencias. *)
  show ?case
  proof -
    have "a (Suc k) \<le> (a k)\<^sup>2"
      by (rule recurrence)
    also have "... \<le> (a 0 ^ (2 ^ k))\<^sup>2"
      by (rule square_bound)
    also have "... = (a 0) ^ (2 ^ Suc k)"
      by (rule trans[OF power_step exponent_step])
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
qed

lemma cu_newton_algebra:
  fixes u v w :: real
  assumes w_nonzero: "w \<noteq> 0"
    and numerator_bound:
      "\<bar>u - w * v\<bar> \<le> \<bar>w\<bar> * \<bar>v\<bar> / 2"
  shows "\<bar>v - u / w\<bar> \<le> \<bar>v\<bar> / 2"
proof -
  (* Reescribimos el error como el cociente del residuo por el denominador. *)
  have error_eq: "v - u / w = (w * v - u) / w"
    using w_nonzero by (simp add: field_simps)
  have wabs_pos: "0 < \<bar>w\<bar>"
    using w_nonzero by simp

  (* Dividir la cota del residuo por el denominador da la cota deseada. *)
  have quotient_bound:
    "\<bar>u - w * v\<bar> / \<bar>w\<bar> \<le> \<bar>v\<bar> / 2"
  proof -
    have divided:
      "\<bar>u - w * v\<bar> / \<bar>w\<bar> \<le>
        (\<bar>w\<bar> * \<bar>v\<bar> / 2) / \<bar>w\<bar>"
      by (rule divide_right_mono[OF numerator_bound]) (use wabs_pos in simp)
    also have "\<dots> = \<bar>v\<bar> / 2"
      using wabs_pos by (simp add: field_simps)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed

  (* La igualdad de valores absolutos concluye la estimación. *)
  have "\<bar>v - u / w\<bar> = \<bar>u - w * v\<bar> / \<bar>w\<bar>"
    using w_nonzero error_eq
    by (simp add: abs_div abs_minus_commute)
  also have "\<dots> \<le> \<bar>v\<bar> / 2"
    by (rule quotient_bound)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma cu_medio_en_intervalo:
  fixes l u :: real
  assumes orden: "l \<le> u"
  shows "l \<le> (l + u) / 2 \<and> (l + u) / 2 \<le> u"
proof -
  (* Expresamos el punto medio duplicado sin divisiones. *)
  have dos_medio: "2 * ((l + u) / 2) = l + u"
    by (simp add: field_simps)

  (* Comparamos los extremos tras duplicar las desigualdades. *)
  have dos_izquierda: "2 * l \<le> l + u"
    using orden by linarith
  have dos_derecha: "l + u \<le> 2 * u"
    using orden by linarith

  (* Las comparaciones anteriores dan las dos cotas del punto medio. *)
  show ?thesis
    using dos_medio dos_izquierda dos_derecha by linarith
qed

lemma cu_mitad_longitud:
  fixes l u :: real
  shows "(l + u) / 2 - l = (u - l) / 2 \<and>
         u - (l + u) / 2 = (u - l) / 2"
proof -
  (* Cada distancia desde el punto medio es la mitad de la longitud. *)
  have izquierda: "(l + u) / 2 - l = (u - l) / 2"
    by (simp add: field_simps)
  have derecha: "u - (l + u) / 2 = (u - l) / 2"
    by (simp add: field_simps)
  show ?thesis using izquierda derecha by blast
qed

lemma cu_divide_power_two_half:
  fixes d :: real and k :: nat
  shows "(d / 2 ^ k) / 2 = d / 2 ^ Suc k"
proof -
  (* El exponente sucesor incorpora el factor dos en el denominador. *)
  show ?thesis
    by (simp add: power_Suc field_simps; algebra)
qed

lemma cu_midpoint_bounds:
  fixes x y :: real
  assumes xy: "x \<le> y"
  shows "x \<le> (x + y) / 2 \<and> (x + y) / 2 \<le> y"
proof -
  (* La identidad de duplicación elimina la división del razonamiento de orden. *)
  have twice: "2 * ((x + y) / 2) = x + y"
    by (simp add: field_simps)

  (* Con la identidad anterior, ambas cotas se reducen a aritmética lineal. *)
  have lower: "x \<le> (x + y) / 2"
    using xy twice by linarith
  have upper: "(x + y) / 2 \<le> y"
    using xy twice by linarith
  show ?thesis
    using lower upper by blast
qed

lemma cu_split_interval:
  fixes x y :: real and c :: bool
  assumes xy: "x \<le> y"
  shows
    "x \<le> fst (if c then (x, (x + y) / 2) else ((x + y) / 2, y)) \<and>
     fst (if c then (x, (x + y) / 2) else ((x + y) / 2, y)) \<le>
       snd (if c then (x, (x + y) / 2) else ((x + y) / 2, y)) \<and>
     snd (if c then (x, (x + y) / 2) else ((x + y) / 2, y)) \<le> y"
proof -
  (* El punto medio está entre los extremos, por lo que ambas mitades son intervalos válidos. *)
  have mid: "x \<le> (x + y) / 2 \<and> (x + y) / 2 \<le> y"
    using cu_midpoint_bounds[OF xy] .
  show ?thesis
    using mid by (cases c) auto
qed

lemma cu_product_sign_switch:
  fixes x y z :: real
  assumes xy: "x * y \<le> 0"
    and xz: "0 < x * z"
  shows "z * y \<le> 0"
proof -
  (* El producto estrictamente positivo implica que x no es cero. *)
  have x_nonzero: "x \<noteq> 0"
  proof
    assume "x = 0"
    with xz show False by simp
  qed

  (* Separamos los casos según el signo de x. *)
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "0 < x")
    case True

    (* Si x es positivo, y no puede ser positivo. *)
    have y_nonpos: "y \<le> 0"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> y \<le> 0"
      then have "0 < y" by linarith
      with True have "0 < x * y" by (rule mult_pos_pos)
      with xy show False by linarith
    qed

    (* La positividad de x*z fuerza que z sea positivo. *)
    have z_pos: "0 < z"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> 0 < z"
      then have z_nonpos: "z \<le> 0" by linarith
      have x_nonneg: "0 \<le> x" using True by linarith
      have "x * z \<le> 0"
        using x_nonneg z_nonpos by (rule mult_nonneg_nonpos)
      with xz show False by linarith
    qed

    (* El producto de un número no negativo y uno no positivo es no positivo. *)
    have z_nonneg: "0 \<le> z" using z_pos by linarith
    from z_nonneg y_nonpos show ?thesis by (rule mult_nonneg_nonpos)
  next
    case False

    (* Como x no es cero, en este caso x es estrictamente negativo. *)
    have x_nonpos: "x \<le> 0" using False by linarith
    have x_neg: "x < 0" using x_nonzero x_nonpos by linarith

    (* Si y fuera negativo, el producto x*y sería positivo. *)
    have y_nonneg: "0 \<le> y"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> 0 \<le> y"
      then have "y < 0" by linarith
      with x_neg have "0 < x * y" by (rule mult_neg_neg)
      with xy show False by linarith
    qed

    (* La positividad de x*z fuerza que z sea negativo. *)
    have z_neg: "z < 0"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> z < 0"
      then have z_nonneg: "0 \<le> z" by linarith
      have "x * z \<le> 0"
        using x_nonpos z_nonneg by (rule mult_nonpos_nonneg)
      with xz show False by linarith
    qed

    (* El producto de un número no positivo y uno no negativo es no positivo. *)
    have z_nonpos: "z \<le> 0" using z_neg by linarith
    from z_nonpos y_nonneg show ?thesis by (rule mult_nonpos_nonneg)
  qed
qed

lemma cu_product_sign_step:
  fixes p q r :: real
  assumes pq: "p * q \<le> 0"
    and not_pr: "\<not> p * r \<le> 0"
  shows "r * q \<le> 0"
proof -
  (* El producto p*r es estrictamente positivo. *)
  have pr: "0 < p * r" using not_pr by linarith
  have pne: "p \<noteq> 0" using pr by auto
  have p_cases: "p < 0 \<or> 0 < p" using pne by linarith
  (* Separamos los dos posibles signos de p. *)
  from p_cases show ?thesis
  proof
    assume pneg: "p < 0"
    (* Si p es negativo, r también debe ser negativo. *)
    have rneg: "r < 0"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume nr: "\<not> r < 0"
      have rnonneg: "0 \<le> r" using nr by linarith
      have ple: "p \<le> 0" using pneg by linarith
      have "p * r \<le> 0"
        by (rule mult_nonpos_nonneg[OF ple rnonneg])
      with pr show False by linarith
    qed
    (* El producto p*q no positivo fuerza q a ser no negativo. *)
    have qnonneg: "0 \<le> q"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume nq: "\<not> 0 \<le> q"
      have qneg: "q < 0" using nq by linarith
      have "0 < p * q" by (rule mult_neg_neg[OF pneg qneg])
      with pq show False by linarith
    qed
    have rle: "r \<le> 0" using rneg by linarith
    show ?thesis by (rule mult_nonpos_nonneg[OF rle qnonneg])
  next
    assume ppos: "0 < p"
    (* Si p es positivo, r también debe ser positivo. *)
    have rpos: "0 < r"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume nr: "\<not> 0 < r"
      have rle: "r \<le> 0" using nr by linarith
      have pnonneg: "0 \<le> p" using ppos by linarith
      have "p * r \<le> 0"
        by (rule mult_nonneg_nonpos[OF pnonneg rle])
      with pr show False by linarith
    qed
    (* El producto p*q no positivo fuerza q a ser no positivo. *)
    have qle: "q \<le> 0"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume nq: "\<not> q \<le> 0"
      have qpos: "0 < q" using nq by linarith
      have "0 < p * q" by (rule mult_pos_pos[OF ppos qpos])
      with pq show False by linarith
    qed
    have rnonneg: "0 \<le> r" using rpos by linarith
    show ?thesis by (rule mult_nonneg_nonpos[OF rnonneg qle])
  qed
qed
